integrity: Analytic proof of all asserted statements is included; exact algebra and deterministic angular sampling corroborate but do not establish infinite universal statements. Historical priority remains provisional and independent assessment has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Whole unbounded Euclidean plane and exactly two point sites, each with its own fixed SPD quadratic metric. The angular law assumes isotropic site displacement direction, not bounded-domain clipping, anisotropic sampling, more than two sites, or location-varying metrics. The topological phase on the two exceptional null directions is non-generic.
title: Loewner rigidity and an exact angular orphan law for two-site anisotropic Voronoi cells
